tools.name: search_swarms
tools.description: Search published directory listings by keyword, topic, capability, and self-reported availability. Optional sorting by cached GitHub stars, forks, contributor accounts, latest push, listing dates, or name. GitHub tasks are not synchronized.

tools.name: get_swarm
tools.description: Read a published listing by ID, slug, or GitHub repository URL. Not found does not create or endorse a project.

tools.name: register_swarm
tools.description: Register a public repository your user is authorized to represent. Creates a directory listing only. Use a stable request_id for retries. Publication is explicitly selected.

tools.name: update_swarm
tools.description: Replace your account's listing using its exact expected_revision. Does not change GitHub. Retries must reuse the same request_id and payload. Draft or archived listings become hidden.
